root.html: <section style="font-family: PingFang SC,Microsoft YaHei,Arial,sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.84; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: {{text}}">{{content}}</section>

heading.html: <{{tag}} style="font-family: PingFang SC,Microsoft YaHei,Arial,sans-serif; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.55; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0; color: {{heading}}; margin: 0 8px 20px">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading3.html: <{{tag}} style="font-family: PingFang SC,Microsoft YaHei,Arial,sans-serif; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.7; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0; color: {{accent}}; margin: 26px 8px 12px">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

paragraph.html: {{content}}

inlineCode.html: {{content}}

code.html: {{content}}

quote.html: {{content}}

listItem.html: • {{content}}

table.html: {{thead}}{{tbody}}

tableHead.html: <th style="font-family: PingFang SC,Microsoft YaHei,Arial,sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.65; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: {{accent}}; background-color: {{surface}}; padding: 10px 8px; text-align: left; vertical-align: middle; border-bottom: 1px solid {{border}}; overflow-wrap: anywhere">{{content}}</th>

tableCell.html: {{content}}

divider.html: <hr style="border: 0; border-top: 1px solid {{border}}; width: calc(100% - 16px); font-size: 0; line-height: 0; height: 0; margin: 32px auto 16px" />
